lead_raw_text:
The structure of Li6Al2Sb2 (reduced formula Li3AlSb) crystallizes in the cubic space group F-43m (No. 216), with a 10-atom unit cell containing three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows all three elements adopt body-centered-cubic-like local arrangements: Al and Sb each have 8 Li neighbors, while Li has 4 Al and 4 Sb neighbors, all at 2.8994 Å. The geometric neighbor graph is three-dimensional, and validated polyhedron contacts reveal corner-, edge-, and face-sharing among Li-centered 8-vertex polyhedra, with corner- and face-sharing between Al- and Sb-centered polyhedra.
